Cargo

การเก็บตัวอย่างจากก้นถัง

The process of collecting liquid samples from the bottom of a cargo tank to check for water, contaminants, or stratification before or after transfer.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

The process of collecting liquid samples from the bottom of a cargo tank to check for water, contaminants, or stratification before or after transfer.

Operational example

Surveyor to chief officer: Please arrange bottom sampling in all cargo tanks and prepare samples for laboratory analysis.
